title: A pot-in-pot cooler
body: Students in Aavi's school make a pot-in-pot cooler, a simple way to keep fruits and vegetables fresh without electricity. A small earthen pot is placed in the centre of a larger earthen pot. The gap between the two pots is filled with sand, and water is poured into the sand. The top of the small pot is covered with a lid or a wet jute sack. After 4-5 hours, the inside of the small pot becomes noticeably cooler. The students keep some vegetables inside and add water to the sand every day to keep it moist. They notice that the cooler works better on some days than on others.
